title: Canonical single-complex transport of the scalar-adjunction counit
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be affine [def-pc-scheme], put $A=f_*\mathcal O_X$, and assume derived module categories of $X,Y,A$ exist [def-pc-derived-category, def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Write $G=Rg_*$ and $T$ for scalar restriction, and assume $T$ is exact. Let $M$ be quasi-coherent on $X$ and $L$ any module on $Y$. Let $H:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ be additive and exact, with adjunction $T\dashv H$. Let $\gamma:D(T)\circ G\cong Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] be precisely the inverse exact-composition comparison followed by the derived image of the identity $T\circ g_*=f_*$. For any isomorphism $e:G(M[0])\cong RH(L[0])$, there is an isomorphism $j:g_*M\cong H(L)$ such that $(T(j)\gg\varepsilon_{H,L})[0]=c_f(M)\gg\gamma_{M[0]}^{-1}\gg D(T)(e)\gg\varepsilon^D_{L[0]}$. Here $c_f(M)$ is the inverse termwise single comparison followed by the right-derived unit, and $\varepsilon^D$ is the counit of the derived adjunction of $T\dashv H$.

source.place: Tag 0AVW, lemma-affine-morphism, final pushforward identification; Tag 0AX3, remark-trace-map-finite

proof.text: Form cg from the inverse termwise single comparison and the right-derived unit for g. Its image under exact scalar restriction and the canonical gamma is cf. The affine single-pushforward theorem makes cf invertible. Exact restriction reflects derived isomorphisms because it commutes with cohomology and reflects isomorphisms of underlying abelian sheaves. Hence cg is invertible.

Compose cg, e, and the exact-H single comparison, giving an isomorphism of single complexes over A. Full faithfulness of the single functor lifts it uniquely to j. The derived-adjunction counit formula on L[0] and naturality of exact-T single comparison give single(T(j) followed by the underived counit). The localization factorization for the specified gamma changes the initial factors to cf followed by gamma inverse, yielding the displayed equation.

theorem finite_exactHom_single_counit_transport
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    [IsAffineHom f]
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent) (L : Y.Modules)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
      (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) f.toRingCatSheafHom)]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
      (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) f.toRingCatSheafHom)]
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))
    [H.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    (adjH : SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
        (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) f.toRingCatSheafHom ⊣ H)
    (γ : RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f) ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
        (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) f.toRingCatSheafHom).mapDerivedCategory ≅
        schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (hγ : γ =
      (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f))
        (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
        (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) f.toRingCatSheafHom)).symm ≪≫
      Functor.rightDerivedFunctorNatIso
        (show RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f) ⋙
          SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
        (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) f.toRingCatSheafHom ≅
          RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom from Iso.refl _))
    (e : (RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M) ≅
      H.rightDerivedFunctor.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj L)) :
    ∃ j : (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj M ≅ H.obj L,
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
        (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) f.toRingCatSheafHom).map j.hom ≫
            adjH.counit.app L) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
          (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).inv.app M) ≫
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M)) ≫
        γ.inv.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
        (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) f.toRingCatSheafHom).mapDerivedCategory.map
          e.hom ≫
        adjH.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction.counit.app
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj L)
